model_output.cross_horizon_summary: The supplied evidence favors near-term BTC/alt divergence, followed by a low-confidence downside-retest bias over 72h; it does not establish a net 168h direction. BTC resilience and modest breadth improvement coexist with weak ETH/BTC, predominantly declining alt proxies, negative settled ETF flows and slightly contracting short-window stablecoin supply. Stabilization is not continuation, and broad altcoin transmission remains weak. These are descriptive, non-binding forecasts with no portfolio execution authority. The Cycle Navigator prior is contextual, not an independent confirming vote.
global_missing_evidence: No multi-session spot-volume, order-flow or derivatives sequence establishes whether the latest improvement can persist.
Canonical large-cap and broad-alt breadth remain unconfirmed. Capitalization buckets are proxies, the small-alt bucket covers only the Top-100 tail, and microcaps are unavailable.
Stablecoin deployment is not established; supply changes do not demonstrate capital entering risk assets.
The latest settled ETF observation is October 16 and is unchanged since the prior packet; it is not a new flow confirmation.
Macro observations have different publication lags and provide no supplied trend sequence or verified forward catalyst schedule.
Hourly funding-event rates are unavailable, although earlier live-anchor funding observations are supplied. Microstructure snapshots are older than the latest completed hourly candle.
